name: Fish tacos
intro: San Diego's taco, made with this month's fish. Seared, not fried, and finished in the time it takes to warm the tortillas.

proteins.name: Rockfish
proteins.timing: Seared 3–4 minutes without moving, flipped, 1–2 minutes more. Flaked in the pan.

steps.text: Salt the fish and leave it on a plate. Pat it completely dry right before it goes in the pan.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until they blister in spots. Stack them under a towel.
Heat a thin film of oil in a heavy skillet until it shimmers. Lay the fish in, away from you.
Don't touch it. It's ready to flip when it lets go of the pan on its own. Flip, then 1–2 minutes more until it's opaque all the way through.
Flake the fish in the pan with a fork.
Two tortillas, fish, arugula, then your flavor. Lime last.

leftovers: Leftover fish is good cold the next day, on toast with lemon and olive oil.
